upgrade_rule: The exact clean c6ec-prepared merge may be upgraded only to a descendant package with control-only delta; new merge parents are [old prepared, exact new package].
materialization_rule: START_CONTINUATION.sh, semantic handoff, and Codex prompt are repository files in the exact package commit. No external ZIP is a prerequisite.
identity_policy: Package exact SHA selects control bytes. Raw receipt SHA binds provenance. Numerical/scientific acceptance uses semantic projection and gates rather than wrapper/package byte equality.
pass_transition: After readiness, immediately resume the five original WU-05 source repairs; do not open another package-review cycle.
on_failure: preserve current state/logs; abort conflicts; never reset/stash/rebase/amend/force-update
review_policy: reuse the existing single fresh repair review and final differential audit; no new review layer
